articles.summary: Publication in Cancer Research Communications establishes the recommended dose for expansion and a clinically translatable dosing strategy for the planned Phase 1b/2a trial (NCT07431216) LP-184 was generally well tolerated in 16 heavily pretreated patients with recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) enrolled in a 63-patient Phase 1a study in advanced solid tumors, which established the recommended dose for expansion (RDE) In orthotopic GBM patient-derived xenograft models, three daily doses of spironolactone reduced tumor levels of the DNA repair protein ERCC3 by approximately 80% and approximately doubled LP-184-induced tumor cell death Pharmacokinetic modeling based on clinical data from Phase 1a patients projects that LP-184 at the RDE, combined with spironolactone, will reach intratumoral concentrations approximately 2- to 3-fold above those needed to kill GBM cells Lantern Pharma Inc. (NASDAQ: LTRN), a clinical-stage AI-driven precision oncology company, and its wholly owned subsidiary
articles.title: Lantern Pharma Announces Peer-Reviewed Publication of Phase 1a LP-184 Data in Recurrent Glioblastoma, Supporting a Phase 1b/2a Combination Trial with Spironolactone
